topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I know the space you're eyeing, the patch by the fence where the morning sun lingers. I understand the need, the pull to nurture roots and shoots. It’s a good spot, rich with potential. I’ve seen the way you tend your own plot, the care in your hands, and I believe in what you could do there. But, the thought of the fence coming down, of mixing our spaces, it stirs a hesitance in me. I hope you understand. Perhaps we can find a way, a compromise that honors both our needs. Let’s talk more, find a path forward together.
